title: The tester's proofs reach the temp directory only through the scratch door again
intention: The tester's proofs reach the system temp directory only through the scratch door again: the two bare mkdtemp calls 25ee4866642e's proof added on 2026-10-13 take their directory from the scratch door, so the tester's own scratch-door tooth (017d8298662a) reads green.
why: Measured 2026-10-30: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_testers_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py' reds, naming cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_proof_does_not_inherit_the_callers_git_env.py:46 (d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-proof-gitenv-subject-"), inside the SUBJECT child-script string) and :81 (work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-proof-gitenv-outer-")) in _run). 017d8298662a PROVED that tooth green; 25ee4866642e (PROVED, 2026-10-13) added the file after. Law 9: a PROVED tooth gone red is red until fixed.
traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics for the tester only while its sealed tooth reds a bare reach) and Law 9 (red is the default; a PROVED tooth gone red is fixed, never explained away). RULE 1: the edit and its tooth are both inside cairn/devices/tester/.
how: EXISTS cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_proof_does_not_inherit_the_callers_git_env.py: (1) inside the SUBJECT string, the child's first line 'import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile' becomes 'import os, subprocess, sys' and line :46 'd = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-proof-gitenv-subject-")' becomes 'd = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "subject-repo"); os.makedirs(d)' (the subject file lives in the scratch work dir, so its repo does too); (2) in _run() line :81 'work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cairn-proof-gitenv-outer-"))' becomes 'work = Path(scratch_dir("cairn-proof-gitenv-outer-"))', with 'from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch import scratch_dir' added after the sys.path insert; the try/finally rmtree stays; the module-level 'import tempfile' is removed if nothing else uses it. EXISTS cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_testers_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py: its PROVES gains '"008baf08f4d8": {"all": "test_the_testers_proofs_name_no_bare_temp_reach"}' beside the 017d8298662a entry; no tooth changes. EXISTS cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py publishes scratch_dir and bare_temp_reach.
falsifier: Falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_testers_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, under PROVES for 008baf08f4d8 key 'all', runs green (before the build bare_temp_reach(cairn/devices/tester) names exactly :46 and :81 of cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_proof_does_not_inherit_the_callers_git_env.py, after it names nothing), and the git-env proof stays green with every tooth keeping its assertion, both under bin/cairn test --exec. Hollow: revert the git-env proof to the pre-build commit and the scratch-door tooth reds. Wrong intent if the subject cannot make its repo without the system temp directory. proven_by = cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_testers_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py and cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_proof_does_not_inherit_the_callers_git_env.py.
builder_notes: WHERE: one file edited, cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_proof_does_not_inherit_the_callers_git_env.py, and one PROVES line added in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_testers_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py. RUN: bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 <proof>' for each, twice. HOLLOW: bin/cairn test --hollow 008baf08f4d8 --proof <scratch-door tooth> --proof <git-env proof>. ORDER: none beyond the code-seam path.

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder needs: the file and both line numbers; that :46 sits inside the SUBJECT string (a child script), so the fix there is d = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'subject-repo'); os.makedirs(d) with tempfile dropped from the child's import line; that :81 becomes work = Path(scratch_dir('cairn-proof-gitenv-outer-')) with 'from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch import scratch_dir' added beside the module imports; that the module-level import tempfile goes if nothing else uses it; the run command bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 <proof>' for both proofs. The ticket's how and decisions carry each.
